name: Fine-particulate dust transport

sources.title: NASA Mars Global Surveyor TES products

earth_proxy_variables.name: albedo
earth_proxy_variables.limitation: surface reflectance is sensor- and atmosphere-dependent

earth_proxy_variables.name: temperature_range
earth_proxy_variables.limitation: Earth atmosphere and seasonal cycle are not Mars-equivalent

earth_proxy_variables.name: precipitation
earth_proxy_variables.limitation: aridity supports a hypothesis but does not measure dust transport

earth_proxy_variables.name: wind_speed
earth_proxy_variables.limitation: climatological wind does not establish saltation or observed movement

earth_proxy_variables.name: elevation
earth_proxy_variables.limitation: terrain context only

minimum_evidence: At least five Mars regions pass notebook-07 dust-compatible evidence checks; independent Earth follow-up remains required.
alternative_explanations: thermal inertia driven by rock abundance rather than dust

name: Erosion and sediment transport

earth_proxy_variables.name: elevation
earth_proxy_variables.limitation: DEM-derived terrain is not a sediment transport observation

earth_proxy_variables.name: slope
earth_proxy_variables.limitation: requires a documented DEM and resolution

earth_proxy_variables.name: wind_speed
earth_proxy_variables.limitation: does not prove sediment motion

earth_proxy_variables.name: precipitation
earth_proxy_variables.limitation: rainfall erosivity needs a separate documented model

minimum_evidence: Targeted CTX/HiRISE morphology plus independent material or change evidence.

name: Volcanic or basaltic terrain

earth_proxy_variables.name: geology_class
earth_proxy_variables.limitation: Earth lithology is not a Mars mineral measurement

earth_proxy_variables.name: elevation
earth_proxy_variables.limitation: landform context only

earth_proxy_variables.name: roughness
earth_proxy_variables.limitation: resolution-sensitive

minimum_evidence: Independent mineralogy and morphology; no cluster-only volcanic label.

name: Ice/permafrost dynamics

earth_proxy_variables.name: temperature_min
earth_proxy_variables.limitation: Earth radiative and atmospheric conditions differ

earth_proxy_variables.name: snow_or_ice_persistence
earth_proxy_variables.limitation: must be sourced from a documented product

earth_proxy_variables.name: elevation
earth_proxy_variables.limitation: context only

minimum_evidence: Hydrogen evidence, thermal/illumination context, and independent volatile follow-up.
alternative_explanations: seasonal frost without stable subsurface ice

name: Water-driven alteration or hydrated-mineral environments

earth_proxy_variables.name: surface_geology
earth_proxy_variables.limitation: Earth lithology is not proof of equivalent alteration

earth_proxy_variables.name: surface_water_or_hydration
earth_proxy_variables.limitation: product and scale must be documented

earth_proxy_variables.name: elevation
earth_proxy_variables.limitation: context only

minimum_evidence: CRISM-scale spectral confirmation and independent geologic context.

name: Impact/crater terrain
required_feature_distributions: age or modification context where available

earth_proxy_variables.name: crater_database
earth_proxy_variables.limitation: catalogue completeness and preservation differ

earth_proxy_variables.name: elevation
earth_proxy_variables.limitation: terrain context

earth_proxy_variables.name: roughness
earth_proxy_variables.limitation: resolution-sensitive

minimum_evidence: Independent crater morphology, not a circular anomaly alone.
